title: Gravity sewer test.
officialText:
Gravity sewer tests shall consist of plugging the end of the building sewer at the point of connection with
the public sewer, filling the building sewer with water, testing with not less than a 10-foot (3048 mm) head of water and maintaining
such pressure for 15 minutes.
